entity.name: AI predictions on Bing Maps images

lineage.description: Building footprints were compiled by combining OpenStreetMap data (snapshot: 1 November 2020) with AI-predicted building outlines derived from Bing Maps imagery (circa 2016–2019) using a machine learning model developed by Netherlands Red Cross – 510. The dataset was produced to support Philippines Red Cross disaster response operations for Typhoon Goni, providing a spatial inventory of the building stock in Camarines Sur.
